description: République Centrafricaine : Situation des Inondations is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Central African Republic. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
